verdict.rationale: Skills/plugins are documented as plain directories (SKILL.md plus optional scripts/references) that install as ordinary files under .agents/skills, and a real install example shows the skill lands as a readable SKILL.md file — so an engineering lead can read everything after installing. The marketplace manifest also lists plugin source paths pre-install, giving some pre-install visibility. Missing for 10: an explicit documented 'preview/list contents before install' command or dry-run diff view, and any explicit review/audit workflow guidance for leads before approving a skill.
